unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Directed control-plane architecture for a governed multi-agent platform, establishing a policy-gated agent execution surface for regulated enterprise AI workflows.
- bul_unify_002: Aligned enterprise generative-AI adoption to CFO priorities, generating CFO-aligned adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization.
- bul_unify_003: Built evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls into production agent runtimes, delivering audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through monitoring, compressing the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks for client deployments.
- bul_unify_005: Architected distributed cloud and Databricks Lakehouse data infrastructure for agentic workloads, achieving high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms.
- bul_unify_006: Converted bespoke delivery into reusable platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 to support agentic platform commercialization.
